summary: Capability checks send documented flat address/from bodies, and reply bodies omit an unspecified part index while deduplicating validation errors.
reason: The public CLI sent a nested handle_check object and offered no direct capability fields; this does not match Linq v3 HTTP examples. An implicit reply part index and repeated validation errors also obscure the caller intent.
validated_outcome: Synthetic HTTP tests assert flat capability bodies with optional from; message-body tests assert omitted reply part index and deduplicated errors.
